reference.title: Extension points and limitations
reference.shortdesc: Extend the interchange transformations or Python adapter, and account for the plug-in's navigation and preview behavior.

section.title: Extension points

row.entry: XSLT imported after topic2interchangeImpl.xsl. Override z:page-metadata-extra to add sidecar keys, or change another template that produces the topic fragment.
XSLT imported after map2interchangeImpl.xsl. Override z:site-metadata-extra or navigation functions.
Regular HTML5 overrides, because topic fragments come from the HTML5 stylesheets.

section.p: The interchange XSLT namespace is urn:x-dita-interchange, with prefix z. Stage 2 behavior is implemented in python/dita_zensical.

section.title: Navigation behavior
section.p: The navigation model follows the DITA map. Topicheads and titled topicgroups become sections. A topicref with children becomes a section whose first entry is its own page. External links remain links. Refs with toc="no" and resource-only refs are omitted from navigation, although their pages are still built.

ul.li: Family links (parent, child, and sibling) are disabled with args.rellinks=nofamily, because the Zensical navigation and footer provide navigation. Relationship-table links remain available.
zensical serve reloads theme and configuration changes. Re-run DITA-OT after editing DITA topics.
The plug-in ID is com.redhat.zensical. DITA-OT sets dita.plugin.com.redhat.zensical.dir to the installed plug-in directory.
